title: Shortest Paths
difficulty: Hard
position: 6
=== statement
A country has `n` cities joined by `m` two-way roads, each with a length. Find the length of the shortest route from city 1 to every city.
=== input
The first line has `n` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines has a road `u v w`: cities `u` and `v` joined by a road of length `w`.
=== output
Print `n` numbers on one line: the shortest distance from city 1 to cities 1, 2, ..., n, or `-1` for a city that cannot be reached.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 5000
0 <= m <= 20000
0 <= w <= 10^9
=== sample
4 4
1 2 3
2 3 4
1 3 10
3 4 1
--- expected
0 3 7 8
=== sample
3 1
1 2 7
--- expected
0 7 -1
=== test
1 0
--- expected
0
=== test
3 1
1 2 5
--- expected
0 5 -1
=== test
4 4
1 2 1
2 3 1
1 3 5
3 4 0
--- expected
0 1 2 2
=== test
10 15
7 9 2
7 4 12
6 8 11
1 2 8
5 7 18
4 5 12
7 5 14
1 4 19
3 10 14
1 6 20
3 5 20
2 3 17
6 9 10
4 8 15
8 10 16
--- expected
0 8 25 19 31 20 31 31 30 39
